title: Yahoo Finance US Market Watchlist & Price Monitor
description: Track stocks, ETFs, indices, forex, and crypto with current quotes, optional OHLCV analytics, and repeat-run change reports. No login or API key required.

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Company or asset names to look up and resolve to ticker symbols (e.g. "apple", "bitcoin").

includeHistorical.title: Include Historical Prices
includeHistorical.description: If enabled, each quote includes a historical OHLCV time series. Keep this off for the cheapest first run.

historicalRange.title: Historical Range
historicalRange.description: Time range for historical data (used when 'Include Historical Prices' is on).

trackChanges.title: Track Changes Between Runs
trackChanges.description: Save bounded private observations and add baseline, updated, unchanged, or partial status to every quote. Also creates Markdown and CSV change reports.

monitorName.title: Watchlist Name
monitorName.description: Stable private name for this scheduled watchlist. Reuse the same name to compare later runs.

observationHistoryLimit.title: Private History per Ticker
observationHistoryLimit.description: Maximum recent observations retained per symbol in the private watchlist store.

priceChangePercentThreshold.title: Price Change Signal (%)
priceChangePercentThreshold.description: Mark a ticker updated when its current price moves by at least this percentage from the previous watchlist observation.

volumeChangePercentThreshold.title: Volume Change Signal (%)
volumeChangePercentThreshold.description: Mark a ticker updated when reported volume moves by at least this percentage from the previous observation.

near52WeekBoundaryPercent.title: Near 52-Week High/Low (%)
near52WeekBoundaryPercent.description: Add a descriptive signal when price is within this percentage of the reported 52-week high or low.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Yahoo Finance is generally open; enable proxies to avoid rate limits on large runs.
